# Platform marks

The GitHub, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, Threads, Spotify and TikTok icon paths are retained from the original FN Squad project. The project credited [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) and its [CC0 1.0 licence](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).

The Discord symbol is from the [Discord brand kit](https://discord.com/branding). The WhatsApp icon is from the [WhatsApp website](https://www.whatsapp.com/). The marks identify linked services. Trademark rights remain with their owners.
